_meta.title: Excluded material — must not be published or attributed
_meta.purpose: A standing record of what must not appear in the portfolio and why. Kept in the repository so that an exclusion decided once is not quietly reversed by later work or by a future search result.
_meta.data_handling_rule: Reasons in this file describe the category of sensitive material without restating it. This file must never contain the phone numbers, personal names, financial figures, transaction identifiers, tracking numbers or roster contents that it exists to keep out of the repository.

entities.name: The Slim Podcast
entities.reason: It is not Bobbi Andrea's project and Bobbi does not have sufficient ownership/rights/relationship to present it as his work.
must_not_use: its description as Bobbi Andrea's biography
its name in structured data or schema markup
any role associated with it to describe Bobbi Andrea
entities.origin: Earlier research incorrectly attributed a relationship between Bobbi Andrea and this podcast. The attribution was wrong and has been withdrawn. Bobbi Andrea does not claim ownership and does not have the level of relationship with it required for it to appear as his work.
entities.replacement: The media experience to represent instead is 'Blockchain & AI radio show — DC Radio', recorded as dc-radio-blockchain-ai-show in work.json.
entities.instruction: Do not include The Slim Podcast anywhere in portfolio-facing content, in any section, in any capacity, including as a mention or a link. It exists only in this exclusion record so that it cannot accidentally be reintroduced later. If it resurfaces in a future search result, treat this entry as authoritative and do not re-add it.
entities.repository_status: No reference to The Slim Podcast exists anywhere in this repository's files. Verified by search. Nothing needed removing; this record is preventative.

excluded_framings._note: Ways of presenting true facts that would still be misleading, recorded so they are not reintroduced during the design and copy phases.

items.framing: BCSA presented as active, ongoing, currently operating, currently recruiting, or currently running programmes
items.instruction: Past tense only. Status labels must read Completed or Archived, never Active.

items.framing: A 'BUILT ON BASE' badge or status tag used as a personal-site endorsement
items.instruction: Do not use. Base appears as part of Bobbi's work and history, not as the owner of the portfolio.

items.framing: Base's brand colour treated as Bobbi Andrea's own brand identity
items.instruction: Use a distinct personal accent instead. The current stylesheet uses Base's exact brand blue in a token named --base-blue; this is to be replaced with a personal accent in the design phase.

items.framing: Base's logo or wordmark used as Bobbi Andrea's identity, or language implying official Base affiliation
items.instruction: Do not use. Base may be mentioned factually where relevant.

items.framing: The BCSA visual identity used in a way that makes the personal portfolio look like the official BCSA website
items.instruction: Do not carry over the BCSA wordmark or identity as the portfolio's own.

items.framing: SWICE reduced to 'a trading project' or 'a trading bot'
items.instruction: SWICE is a personal AI OS with a deterministic financial execution subsystem. Trading is one capability, not the identity.

items.framing: SWICE implied to be a commercially deployed autonomous financial product
items.instruction: It is in development, not publicly available as a finished product, not production software, and not a live-money trading service.

items.framing: Internal engineering milestones such as a passing test count presented as public product achievements
items.instruction: Internal project history is not marketing copy. Only explicitly approved technical detail may be published.

items.framing: 'Bobbi used to do random things and now builds a trading bot'
items.instruction: The trajectory is progression, not replacement. The earlier creative, music, design, radio and community work is what led to the current software and AI direction, and SWICE is the current flagship rather than the whole identity.

items.framing: The gallery filled with cafe interiors, food photographs or unrelated images to avoid an empty section
items.instruction: Defer the gallery instead.

items.framing: A screenshot of a social-media photos tab presented as a headshot
items.instruction: There is no headshot in this repository. Leave it as a pending asset; do not substitute and do not fabricate a portrait.

items.framing: Random generated points or decorative geography presented as real ecosystem data
items.instruction: The old BCSA Ecosystem Map and Regional Footprint visualisations are based on randomly generated positions and are approved for removal. Technical visualisation must communicate something real or remain clearly atmospheric.

items.framing: Third-party platform links retained merely because they existed on the old BCSA site
items.instruction: Remove from a personal portfolio's navigation.

items.framing: Empty startup language such as revolutionary, game-changing, world-class, industry-leading or visionary
items.instruction: Do not use without a specific factual basis. Explain what Bobbi Andrea actually did.

items.framing: Ecosystem participation written as ownership or founding
items.instruction: 'Worked within the Base ecosystem' is not 'founded Base'. Applies equally to Zora, Farcaster, Coinbase and Ethereum.

items.framing: Employment history flattened into 'projects'
items.instruction: Employment, roles, projects, creative work, media and experiments are distinct types and must be presented as such.

items.framing: The graphic-design career or the music and radio history omitted because software and AI is the current focus
items.instruction: The site must show evolution, not replace the earlier chapters.

items.framing: Bobbi reduced to a single identity: Web3 person, community manager, graphic designer, musician, or developer
items.instruction: The portfolio exists to show the whole trajectory and how the disciplines connect.

items.framing: The dossier's expansion pipeline of named prospective institutions presented as achieved or current
items.instruction: It was future-facing at time of writing. Either reframe as historical intent or remove.

items.framing: SongChain presented as Bobbi's project
items.instruction: Recorded as third-party work. See the songchain entry in work.json.

items.framing: Quantitative claims restated because they already appear in this repository
items.instruction: Every figure in the quarantined_claims list requires an explicit per-item decision. Default if undecided is to omit.

outstanding_cleanup._note: Cannot be completed from within this repository. Recorded so it is not forgotten.

items.detail: The removed files exist in earlier commits. This repository is public, so they remain retrievable from the hosting provider until history is rewritten. Rewriting was deliberately deferred pending a separate decision.

This project has been deployed to Vercel. Past deployments are retained at their own immutable URLs and continue to serve the removed files independently of the current branch state. They must be deleted from the hosting dashboard by the account owner.
The removals are on a working branch. The production deployment tracks the default branch and will continue serving the removed files until the change is merged.

Search engines, social card scrapers and archiving services may hold independent copies. One removed file was the site's Open Graph share image, so it may be cached by any platform where a link to the site was posted.

approved_decisions._note: Explicitly directed and safe to implement in the design and content phases without asking again.
items: Replace Base's exact brand blue with a distinct personal accent.
Remove third-party platform links from navigation.
Remove the BCSA Ecosystem Map and Regional Footprint WebGL visualisations, which are based on randomly generated positions.
Keep the hero WebGL atmosphere, which is technically sound, and keep the existing typography, grid logic, panels, restrained motion and editorial structure.
Defer the gallery until suitable material exists.
Create a typographic Open Graph image, since no safe personal photography exists.
Keep the zero-build static architecture — static HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript, static assets; introduce no component framework.
Keep content visible without JavaScript; JavaScript may enhance filtering, animation and interaction but must never be required to access content.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion, keyboard navigation, touch navigation, semantic HTML, responsive design, graceful WebGL failure and performance.
Use clean URLs at /work/, /work/swice/, /work/bcsa/, /archive/bcsa-report/ and /about/, with /report.html redirecting to the archive.
Do not create the later project pages (/work/crypto-4-nilubilo/, /work/music/, /work/dc-radio/, /work/design/, /work/experiments/) until their content is sufficiently known.
Use 'Blockchain & AI radio show — DC Radio' as the neutral display formulation until the exact title and role are confirmed.
